headline: Anthropic launches Opus 5, a cheaper and less restrictive AI model, while the US weighs response to Chinese AI and industry urges against broad open-weight restrictions
tldr: Today's AI news is dominated by new model launches, including Anthropic's Opus 5, and the ongoing debate over AI regulation and restrictions. OpenAI's new AI keypad and voice mode for ChatGPT are also making waves, while researchers are making breakthroughs in areas like tabular LLMs and AI memory systems. The industry is also seeing significant acquisitions and expansions, including Midjourney's purchase of Co-Star and Cognition's acquisition of Poke.

new_models.title: Anthropic launches Opus 5
new_models.summary: Opus 5 will be both cheaper and less restrictive than Fable, likely making it preferable in most use cases.
new_models.why_it_matters: This launch reflects the rapid pace of innovation in the AI industry and the growing demand for more accessible and affordable AI models.

new_models.title: OpenAI’s new AI keypad
new_models.summary: OpenAI's fancy new AI keypad will be a lot of fun for some, while many others are probably not going to touch it.
new_models.why_it_matters: This new keypad represents a unique approach to human-AI interaction and could potentially open up new possibilities for coders and developers.

research.title: Tabular LLMs: An Introduction to the Foundation Models That Predict Your Spreadsheet
research.summary: Tabular foundation models predict the missing column of any spreadsheet zero-shot, the way an LLM completes text — and on the TabArena benchmark they now sit above fully tuned gradient-boosted trees.
research.why_it_matters: This research highlights the growing capabilities of LLMs in areas like data prediction and completion, which could have significant implications for industries like finance and accounting.

research.title: Loop Engineering for RAG Generation: An LLM Cascade from a Cheap Local Model Up to a Hosted Flagship
research.summary: Enterprise Document Intelligence [Vol.1 #8quater] - Two angles on the cascade, cost and a validation loop, backed by a real sweep of twenty local models against a hosted flagship
research.why_it_matters: This research demonstrates the potential for LLMs to be used in a cascaded approach, where cheaper local models can be used to improve the performance of more expensive hosted models.

features_updates.title: OpenAI’s new voice mode makes it to the ChatGPT desktop app
features_updates.summary: ChatGPT Voice on desktop can work with both ChatGPT Work and Codex to complete tasks and control agents.
features_updates.why_it_matters: This update reflects the growing demand for more natural and intuitive human-AI interaction, and could potentially open up new possibilities for users with disabilities or preferences for voice-based interfaces.

features_updates.title: Bluesky’s AI assistant Attie expands into an open social research tool
features_updates.summary: Users can now ask Attie questions about news, trends, and conversations on Bluesky and other apps on the AT Protocol.
features_updates.why_it_matters: This expansion reflects the growing potential for AI assistants to be used in social research and analysis, and could potentially open up new possibilities for researchers and analysts.

industry_business.title: Why Cognition bought Poke: AI personality is becoming a competitive advantage
industry_business.summary: The acquisition brings Poke’s conversational style and interaction model to Cognition’s coding agent Devin, reflecting a growing belief that how AI assistants interact with users is as important as the models powering them.
industry_business.why_it_matters: This acquisition highlights the growing importance of AI personality and interaction in the industry, and could potentially reflect a shift towards more human-centered AI design.

industry_business.title: Midjourney acquired the astrology app Co-Star
industry_business.summary: The AI lab Midjourney continues to expand its purview beyond image and video generation.
industry_business.why_it_matters: This acquisition reflects the growing diversification of AI companies and their expanding range of applications and use cases.

policy_society.title: As US weighs response to Chinese AI, industry urges against broad open-weight restrictions
policy_society.summary: AI companies, including Nvidia and Mistral, urge policymakers to avoid broad restrictions on open-weight AI models as Washington debates responses to Chinese AI and alleged model distillation.
policy_society.why_it_matters: This debate highlights the growing tensions between the US and China over AI, and the potential implications for the global AI industry and its development.

policy_society.title: Canadian legislator reads out apparent LLM response in floor speech
policy_society.summary: A Canadian legislator read out a response that appeared to be generated by a large language model (LLM) in a floor speech, highlighting the growing use of AI in politics and governance.
policy_society.why_it_matters: This incident reflects the growing use of AI in politics and governance, and the potential implications for transparency, accountability, and decision-making.
